sources: 2025-07-08 Report on the Implementation ... until 30 June 2025 (att 11: 3,102,000 shares, budget USD3,400,000 = Rp55,409,800,000)

2026-04-01 Information Disclosure regarding Termination (att 31 Indonesian / att 32 English)
programs.notes: AGMS 3 Jun 2025 approved 4 Jun 2025 - 3 Jun 2026, max USD3,400,000 (= Rp55,409,800,000). Board resolved on 31 Mar 2026 to terminate early. The termination filing gives 53,283,500 treasury shares (1.19%) and USD1,370,885 used (USD2,029,115 unused). The 2026-04-06 plan instead calls the prior period '4 Juni 2025 sampai 30 Maret 2026'; the dedicated termination filing (31 Mar) is used here. DB accumulated 50,181,500 is only the H2-2025 report total. Correct figure: 3,102,000 (H1) + 50,181,500 (H2) = 53,283,500, which already matches the transaction_details sum (70 trades, 2025-06-11 to 2025-12-24, all within the period). DB utilized Rp22,586,500,959 = 55,299,201,804 (fund net of est. fees, per report note 3) - 32,712,700,845 remaining at 24 Dec 2025. That is derived, not a stated total; the official total is USD1,370,885 with no IDR figure, so no correction is given. No purchases after 24 Dec 2025 (share total unchanged at termination).
